newsitem.title: USA: Ten Coast Guard marchers to miss parade.
newsitem.headline: Ten Coast Guard marchers to miss parade.

text.p: Ten of the 60 members of the U.S. Coast Guard honour guard will miss Monday's inaugural parade because of disciplinary proceedings, a Coast Guard spokesman said Sunday.
The alleged offences range from allowing a teenager to use an identification card to get into a bar to bringing a hunting rifle into barracks, spokesman Jack O'Dell said.
A Captain's Mast, or hearing, has been scheduled next week on the alleged infractions, the Coast Guard said in a statment.
"While the hearing is pending, the Coast Guard has decided that the members will not participate in inaugural activities and are being assigned to other duties," the statement said.
The Coast Guard also said it had begun an investigation into allegations of hazing within the honour guard, which would be in violation of its policy.
All of the U.S. military services have marching units in Monday's parade, which goes from the U.S. Capitol to the White House.
